verdict.rationale: Metronome finalizes invoices at period end and pushes them to Stripe or the AWS, Azure and GCP marketplaces for collection, which automates invoice creation and handoff. It also supports custom fields on its objects. Customer-facing delivery and tax compliance appear to rely on these downstream integrations rather than on Metronome itself. Missing for 10: credit notes, receipts, sequential invoice numbering, invoice memos, tax/compliance guarantees, native customer delivery of invoice documents, and independent corroboration.
